texts.preamble: Sanjay vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 13 August, 2015 Crr-1832-2015 (Sanjay Vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh) 13-08-2015 Shri Manish Tiwari, learned counsel for the applicant.
texts.facts: Hence, no further notice is required to be sent to it. Heard on I.A. No. 15248/2015, which is the first application under Section 397(1) of the Cr.P.C. moved on behalf of the applicant for suspension of sentence and grant of bail to him during the pendency of this revision.
texts.arguments: Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant remained on bail during the trial of the case and the pendency of appeal. However, he has been suffering the jail sentence since 31.07.2015, the date of impugned judgment. It is also submitted by him that the revision is of the year 2015 and there is no likelihood of this revision being listed for final hearing in recent future. It is also submitted by him that looking to the quantum of remaining jail sentence, this revision becomes infructuous in case the applicant would have suffered it before this revision being decided on merits. It is also submitted by him that he has a good case on merits. Upon these submissions, learned counsel prays to allow the I.A. Learned Panel Lawyer opposes the prayer.
